comparison.objective: Candidate sets a gripper opening stop; PR-1852 restocks a twin-roll tissue dispenser and closes its cover.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque; PR-1852 coordinates release tabs, roll extraction/insertion, spindle engagement, gate movement, and damped cover closure.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked 90° setting retained over cycles; PR-1852 requires the stub and new roll on specified engaged spindles with the gate clear and cover safely latched.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate mechanisms, but their hardest abilities and terminal states are not equivalent.
